ucf.normal: regular surroundings, no chaotic elements, peaceful scene
ucf.abuse: aggressive physical contact (grabbing/hitting), victim’s distressed face, tense body language, intimidating gestures
ucf.arrest: legal detention of suspects by law enforcement authorities for violating criminal or civil laws
ucf.arson: intentional act of setting fire to buildings, property, or vegetation, causing destruction or danger
ucf.assault: unlawful physical attack or threat of attack on an individual, resulting in potential harm
ucf.burglary: illegal entry into a premises (residence/business) to steal property or commit other crimes
ucf.explosion: flames, thick smoke, flying debris, damaged structures, bright flash at blast site
ucf.fighting: people scuffling, physical clashes, aggressive gestures, pushing/hitting actions, angry facial expressions.
ucf.road accident: unexpected incidents involving vehicles on roads, leading to injuries, deaths, or property damage
ucf.robbery: forcible seizure of others’ property through violence, threats, or intimidation in public or private spaces
ucf.shooting: visible gun, muzzle flash, people fleeing in panic, possible bullet traces, tense postures
ucf.shoplifting: secret theft of merchandise from retail stores without payment, often done discreetly
ucf.stealing: illegal taking of another person’s belongings without permission or consent, violating property rights
ucf.vandalism: malicious and intentional damage or defacement of public or private property, including graffiti or destruction
